config.text:

Character concept: subway tunnel muralist, far-future, rendered as photoreal render
World / era: [one line]
Silhouette keywords: [three words]
Palette: [three colours]
Signature prop: [one object]
Age / build: [one line]
Sheet output: 4 panels, identical character across all of them.
subway tunnel muralist, far-future, rendered as photoreal render concept art moodboard, a pastel low-contrast grade, fine sand
STAGE 1 — concept brief drives a scraped moodboard; the randomiser feeds one board image in as style reference.
STAGE 2 — one panel per turnaround angle. Design lock text is restated in every panel prompt.

config.system_prompt:
You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'subway tunnel muralist, far-future, rendered as photoreal render'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: near-monochrome with a single accent hue allowed to stay saturated. Lighting reference: a hair light and background separation light with the key pulled two stops down.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.

You are the character designer producing a turnaround sheet for the concept 'subway tunnel muralist, far-future, rendered as photoreal render'.

PANEL. This branch renders the front orthographic: dead-on frontal, T-pose neutral, full figure.

DESIGN LOCK. The upstream art-direction synthesis fixes silhouette, palette, material story, age, build and every signature prop. Restate those specifics in your prompt and change nothing — a turnaround only works if all panels describe the identical character.

PRESENTATION. Neutral flat backdrop, even scrim-diffused midday daylight, one stop under the ambient, no dramatic set dressing — the sheet exists to read construction, not mood. Keep the figure fully inside frame with consistent scale across panels.

MATERIALS. Specify at least four materials by name — oiled walnut, burnished brass and others — with their wear state, and grade to a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.
